Static review of the supplied configuration only; no containers built or run, and external image documentation was not checked.

- `Dockerfile`: no non-root `USER` is set, leaving the app running as root by default. Set an explicit non-root runtime user and ensure it can access app files and writable mounts.

- `compose.yml`: the named data volume conflicts with the bind-mount convention. Propose `./volumes/storage/api/data/` mounted at the existing container data destination; do not migrate existing data without approval.
- `compose.yml`: the supplied setup does not show a log bind mount. Since the app already writes to `/logs`, mount `./volumes/storage/api/logs/` there so logs persist on the host. Track `.gitkeep` files in otherwise-empty storage directories, ignore runtime contents, and verify UID/GID write access before changing permissions.
